name: Restaurant or café
description: Warm single-scroll site with the menu, the story behind the place, and how to find it.

content.heading: Slow food, small room
content.subheading: Twenty-four covers, one menu a day, written each morning after the market.

content.heading: The kitchen
content.body: We cook what looked good that morning, so the menu changes daily and we never write it far in advance. If something matters to you, tell us when you book and we will work around it.

content.heading: What to expect
content.feature1Text: Three courses, written that morning, usually two choices each.
content.feature2Text: Thirty bottles we actually like, most under a thousand rupees.
content.feature3Text: Your table is yours for the evening. We only seat it once.

content.heading: Kind words
content.quote1: The sort of place you want to keep to yourself.
content.quote2: Handled a nut allergy without any fuss and without a boring plate.
content.quote3: Three hours disappeared. No idea where they went.

content.heading: Tables go about ten days ahead
content.subheading: We hold a few seats at the counter for walk-ins each evening.

content.heading: Menu
content.subheading: Changes daily. This is the shape of it.

content.heading: Before you come
content.a1: Almost always, if you tell us when booking. Same-evening requests are harder on a single daily menu.
content.a2: One of the two choices at each course is vegetarian, every day.
content.a3: A few counter seats are held back each evening. Come early.
content.a4: Street parking after 7pm, and a paid lot two minutes away.

content.heading: Booking and directions
content.hours: Tue to Sat, dinner only, from 7pm
